art_9.title: Risk Management System
art_9.description: High-risk AI systems must have a risk management system that is iterative and takes into account the entire lifecycle of the system.

art_10.title: Data Governance
art_10.description: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices.
evidence_queries: SELECT * FROM guardrail_events WHERE category = 'S7_privacy' AND action = 'block'
recommendations: Extend privacy filters to training data validation

art_12.title: Logging for Traceability
art_12.description: High-risk AI systems must be designed to enable automatic recording of events over the lifetime of the system.
evidence_queries: SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE event_type = 'guardrail_decision' AND created_at > ?

art_13.title: Transparency
art_13.description: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable users to interpret the system's output.
recommendations: Add human-readable explanations for guardrail blocks

art_14.title: Human Oversight
art_14.description: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons.

art_15.title: Accuracy, Robustness and Cybersecurity
art_15.description: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.

art_50.title: AI-Generated Content
art_50.description: AI systems that generate or manipulate text, images, audio or video shall ensure that the outputs are marked as being AI-generated.
recommendations: Implement digital watermarking for all AI-generated outputs

govern.title: Govern
govern.description: Establish and maintain a risk management culture and governance structure.

map.title: Map
map.description: Identify and document the AI system's context and the risks it may pose.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Assess and measure the AI system's risks and the effectiveness of the guardrails.

manage.title: Manage
manage.description: Prioritize and act upon the risks identified and measured.

ai_management.title: AI Management System
ai_management.description: Establish and maintain an AI management system (AIMS) to manage risks and opportunities.
recommendations: Map policies to ISO 42001 control objectives
